scoring.note: not_applicable criteria are excluded from both the numerator and denominator when computing the weighted score, not treated as zero.

gate_policy.description: Any criterion with is_gate=true that resolves to 'fail' caps the call's overall score and flags it for manager review, independent of the weighted score below. Gate failures are never averaged away by other criteria.
gate_policy.rollout_note: Ship gate fails as 'flag for manager review' only, before auto-applying the score cap in production, until false-positive rate is validated against the human calibration sample.

criteria.name: Required Disclosures & Verification
criteria.description: Checks presence of required fixed-phrase disclosures/verification steps, resolved per call_type against an external config. Phrase wording must come from legal/compliance sign-off, not guessed.

criteria.name: No Rudeness / Hostile Language

terms.profanity_terms: NEEDS TEAM INPUT -- maintain as loadable config, not inline

criteria.llm_question: Does the agent's tone anywhere in this call cross into sarcasm, condescension, or hostility, even if no single word is inappropriate? Cite the specific line.
criteria.description: Deterministic keyword/phrase pass plus an LLM sarcasm/condescension pass. Either layer flagging = fail.

criteria.name: Opening: Greeting & Purpose

purpose_terms: what can i do for you

criteria.description: Purpose terms narrowed from prior version to require agent-initiative framing, not the agent merely echoing what the customer already said.

criteria.name: Opening: Emotional Attunement
criteria.gating_condition: Only scored if customer's opening turns (first 2 customer turns) are classified as carrying an emotional cue (positive or negative). If neutral, verdict is not_applicable.
criteria.question_step_1: Classify the customer's opening turns as emotional_negative, emotional_positive, or neutral.
criteria.question_step_2: If emotional_negative: did the agent show empathy/acknowledgment before problem-solving? If emotional_positive: did the agent acknowledge/share in the good news? Cite the agent line.

criteria.name: Active Listening: No Interruption
criteria.description: Flags agent segments overlapping the prior customer segment beyond the minimum duration, excluding short backchannel acknowledgments.
criteria.calibration_status: overlap_min_duration_sec and backchannel_max_words are starting values, not yet validated against human scoring.

criteria.name: Active Listening: Demonstrated Understanding
criteria.question: Did the agent paraphrase, summarize, or explicitly confirm the customer's problem statement before responding with a solution? Cite the agent's confirming line, or if absent, note where confirmation should have occurred.

criteria.name: Tone: Warmth & Professionalism
criteria.question: Excluding any hostility already caught by the gate check, was the agent's tone consistently polite, warm, and professional throughout the call (not just at open/close)? Cite a representative line; if tone dipped mid-call, cite that moment specifically.

criteria.name: Resolution Status & Effectiveness
criteria.question: Was this issue resolved on the call, or was it escalated because it genuinely required a different team/authority? If escalated, did the agent set a clear expectation for what happens next (what, and roughly when)?

verdict_logic.pass: Fully resolved on the call, OR appropriately escalated with a clear next-step expectation and rough timeline set.
verdict_logic.partial: Resolved only after the customer had to push repeatedly, OR escalated correctly but without a stated timeline/expectation.
verdict_logic.fail: Left hanging with no resolution attempt and no escalation, OR escalated something the agent should reasonably have handled themselves (escalation used as avoidance rather than genuine judgment).

criteria.note: Escalation is not treated as a lesser outcome than resolution -- a warranted escalation with a clear expectation set scores 'pass', same as a full resolution. The LLM must explicitly judge whether escalation was warranted, not just detect that it occurred.

outcome_reconciliation.rule: Cross-check against repeat-contact within 7 days about the same root_cause.
outcome_reconciliation.downgrade_condition: Only downgrade a 'pass' verdict to 'partial' if the recontact happens AFTER the agent's committed timeline, or because no one followed up as promised.
outcome_reconciliation.no_downgrade_condition: Recontact that falls within, or is about, a still-pending and on-time escalation does NOT downgrade the verdict -- this is expected behavior, not a failure signal.
outcome_reconciliation.execution: Runs as a delayed batch job against outcome data, not at initial call-scoring time.

criteria.name: Dead Air & Hold Handling
criteria.description: Detects gaps exceeding the threshold between consecutive segments. A gap preceded by a warning term in the immediately prior agent turn counts as partial, not fail. Severity does not currently scale with number of gaps -- any single unwarned gap is enough for fail.
criteria.calibration_status: gap_threshold_sec is a starting value, not yet validated.

criteria.name: Closure: Recap & Next Steps
criteria.question: Did the agent recap the issue/resolution (or escalation) and state clear, actionable next steps before ending the call?

supporting_terms.note: Deterministic terms above support/corroborate this LLM criterion rather than scoring independently.

criteria.name: Closure: Ownership Stated

terms.team_pattern: [team_name] + 'team' -- team_name list must be pulled from the org's actual department names, kept as external config (e.g. billing, engineering, technical support, retention, escalations, account management)

criteria.description: pass = specific identifier or team pattern matched. partial = vague ownership only. fail = neither. Scope note: this criterion checks only whether ownership was STATED -- it does not re-judge whether escalation itself was warranted, since that judgment is already made in resolution_effectiveness. Avoids double-scoring the same decision under two weighted criteria.

negation_aware_matching.description: All phrase matching across every deterministic criterion above must discard a match if a negation marker appears shortly after it -- prevents e.g. "I can't help with that" from matching commitment/resolution phrase banks.

weight_check.note: Gates carry weight=0 and are excluded from the weighted average entirely -- they act only through gate_policy. If no gate fails, final score = weighted average of the weight>0 criteria, renormalized for any not_applicable exclusions.
